title: Hearty Smoky Argentinian Beef Skewers
description: A smoky and savory Argentinian dish featuring tender beef skewers served with a side of crispy bread and a glassy jelly sauce, perfect for a date night.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread the beef strips onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Grill the skewers for 10 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 135 degrees Fahrenheit.
Meanwhile, slice the long fermentation dough bread into 1 inch thick slices and grill until crispy.
In a small saucepan, combine the dates, red wine vinegar, and 1/4 cup of water and bring to a boil over medium heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened into a glassy jelly.
Serve the beef skewers with the crispy bread and glassy jelly sauce.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.
